title: Iindaba Ezivuyisayo Ebudaleni
intro: Ubona umzuzu apho ithemba livuselelwa khona. Isibini, esidlule kudala kwiminyaka yokuba ngabazali, sifumana isithembiso esichasene nemithetho yendalo. Phakathi kwaso kumi umntu obomi bakhe buphawu lwenceba kaThixo—umphefumlo omiselwe ukuba ngumprofeti, ophethe ilifa eliya kuqhubeka kwizizukulwana ngezizukulwana. Ngubani lo mntu umangalisayo?
clues: Ndazalelwa kubazali ababesele bekhulile kwaye bengenabantwana.
Ukuzalwa kwam kwabhengezwa ziingelosi ezazize njengeendwendwe kusapho lwam.
Ndinikwe ubulumko nobuprofeti, kwaye ndikhankanywa phakathi kwabagulayo.
Utata wayebizwa ngokuba ngumhlobo ka-Allah, kwaye mna ndandisisipho kuye kwiminyaka yakhe yokugqibela.
Ndandinomnakwethu owayengumprofeti, kwaye sobabini sasikelelwa yiNkosi yethu.
Unyana wam naye wayengumprofeti, kwaye inzala yam yanikwa isibhalo nobuprofeti.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
